packageRules.description: stable branches are maintenance branches: patch updates only.
Dependabot only updated GitHub Actions on main; keep that behavior on stable branches.
Do not raise routine major-update PRs. Renovate's vulnerability remediation bypasses packageRules by design, so a major is still raised when it is the lowest version that fixes a known vulnerability.
Auto-merge minor and patch updates once CI is green.

Code-generator bumps must never auto-merge. A @hey-api/* bump touches only package.json and the lockfile, but rewrites thousands of lines of committed output under src/gen — including runtime behaviour of the generated fetch client. Issue #405 (transport errors silently swallowed) shipped exactly that way: the bump PR showed no generated diff and the behavioural change landed in the release commit that regenerates. The blocking `generation-drift` CI job now fails until the regenerated output is committed into the PR, so a human reviews the generated diff. Listed last so it wins over the automerge rule above.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Generator bump — regeneration required.** This PR changes only `package.json` and the lockfile; the committed code under `src/gen` still reflects the previous generator. Run `npm run generate:local`, review the diff (pay particular attention to `src/gen/client/`, `src/gen/CamundaClient.ts` and `src/gen/zod.gen.ts` — these carry runtime behaviour, not just types), and commit it here. The `generation-drift` check stays red until you do.
